title: Geometric Factual Recall in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.12426v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How do transformer language models memorize factual associations? A common account views internal weight matrices as an associative memory. That account requires parameter counts that scale linearly with the number of facts. We develop a theoretical and empirical account of an alternative, \emph{geometric} form of memorization in which learned embeddings encode relational structure directly, and the MLP plays a qualitatively different role. In a controlled setting where a single-layer transformer memorizes random bijections from subjects to a shared attribute set, we prove that a logarithmic embedding dimension is sufficient. Subject embeddings encode \emph{linear superpositions} of their associated attribute vectors, and a small MLP acts as a relation-conditioned selector that extracts the relevant attribute from the embedding. translated_abstract: Transformer语言模型是如何记忆事实关联的？一种常见的观点将内部权重矩阵视为联想记忆，但这种观点要求参数数量随事实数量线性增长。我们提出了一种替代性的几何式记忆形式的理论与实证解释：学习到的嵌入直接编码关系结构，而MLP则扮演性质上截然不同的角色。在一个受控设定中，单层Transformer需要记忆从主体到共享属性集的随机双射映射，我们证明了对数级的嵌入维度就足以完成这一任务。主体嵌入编码其关联属性向量的线性叠加，而一个小型MLP充当受关系条件约束的选择器，从嵌入中提取出相关属性。我们将这些结果进一步扩展到多跳推理场景——即关系查询链，例如“某人的母亲是谁”（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明Transformer可以通过在主体嵌入中编码属性向量的线性叠加、并由小型MLP作为关系条件选择器来提取信息，以对数级嵌入维度实现事实记忆，突破了传统联想记忆要求参数随事实数线性增长的局限。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that transformers can memorize facts with only logarithmic embedding dimension by encoding linear superpositions of attribute vectors in subject embeddings, with a small MLP acting as a relation-conditioned selector, departing from the associative-memory view that requires parameters to scale linearly with the number of facts.
